verdict.rationale: Claude documents a user-initiated data export of conversation and account data via Settings > Privacy (claude-docs-12, claude-docs-40), which supports the 'leave with your data' aspect of the story, but there is no documentation specifying the export format (e.g., JSON/CSV) or confirming it is an open, portable format usable elsewhere. Missing for 10: explicit format specification for exports, confirmation of open/interoperable format, and independent/hands-on verification that exported data can be reused outside Claude.
